searchText: i would like to consider a small modification to 4844 so that it exposes the underlying BLS curve arithmetic as precompiles, rather than the currently monolithic "point evaluation" precompile (cf. `verify_kzg_proof` in the EIP spec) the downside is expanded scope and corresponding requirements for more testing, review, etc. but on the upside we will have something like EIP-2537 which has been "almost to mainnet" for some time and unlocks a lot of use cases around both consensus layer (e.g. more staking pool designs) and zk rollups (which can use the more secure curve over the existing altbn256) the underlying code will already be required for 4844 so this is mainly about exposing the logic via the 4844 interface, rather than adding new functionality
